svg.aria-label: Optional voice tools. Voicebox is a separate tool the box can use for voice, not part of its text path. Voicebox: Local voice cloning and synthesis, Whisper transcription, dictation, effects, stories and MCP speech tools Wiring: Your text path never calls the Voice API. A configured voicebox MCP server can still let OMP request speech while that service runs, which is not an integrated voice-conversation mode Inference: Runs locally, while model downloads, optional cloud features and connected agents can use the network
